note: In the ledger, `sources` holds indices into `sources` below, and method fields hold indices into `methods`.
methods: Population exclusively from owner-supplied, SHA-256-verified PSA 2024 POPCEN files, reference 1 July 2024. Regional municipality totals confirmed against Table B; all parsed barangay sums checked. Identity uses own literal Wikidata P988 (Philippine Standard Geographic Code), else exact name within own municipality plus point, own P31/P131, stored type/local type/level/parent, same state and strict containment in unrepaired NAMRIA/PSA COD-AB polygon. Retained PSGC register supplies identity/code correspondence only, never population. Hold scope, state, parent, raw-geometry or item conflicts. Unresolved keys change only where unchanged original v4 administrative identity is proved; ordinary classification events cite this compact ledger. Never follow a successor or put an administrative total on a settlement or barangay.
exact name in own municipality, same state and raw official polygon
own literal P988 through explicit PSGC correspondence

sources.edition:
Philippines administrative level 0-4 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 03.  
  
This dataset is structured into 4 levels:  
- Admin 1: 17   
- Admin 2: 88   
- Admin 3: 1642   
- Admin 4: 11920   
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 01 April 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 26 March 2018: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 09 February 2018: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 09 February 2018: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Philippines](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-philippines).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global) Source: National Mapping and Resource Information Authority (NAMRIA), Philippines Statistics Authority (PSA)
